source.section: Acceptance criteria for R1, the first usable release

suites.name: OpenAPI, JSON Schema, event, and adapter contracts
Authorization, isolation, injection, and data-leak fixtures
Forward, rollback, and compatibility migration tests
API, workflow, event-stream, and scheduling load tests
Dependency disruption, restart, retry, and reconciliation tests
gVisor runner and preview containment tests
Attributed human verification with immutable evidence
AGPL, source, SBOM, provenance, and release checks

environments.name: Plane API and PostgreSQL test stack
Plane web unit and component test runtime
Local Temporal and Curve worker profile
Disposable provider and VCS conformance projects
Staging gVisor runner and preview pool
Example Organization staging control plane and approved integrations

commands.name: Complete Curve documentation and contract gate
commands.readiness_rule: Required for every Curve contract or planning change.

commands.name: Curve external-link verification
commands.readiness_rule: Required when a changed document adds or changes an external link.

commands.name: Focused Curve backend suite
commands.command: docker compose -f docker-compose-test.yml run --rm --build api-tests pytest plane/curve/tests
commands.readiness_rule: Required for every Curve backend or contract implementation package.

commands.name: Complete Plane backend suite
commands.readiness_rule: Required before accepting a Plane implementation package.

commands.name: Django migration drift check
commands.command: docker compose -f docker-compose-test.yml run --rm api-tests python manage.py makemigrations --check --dry-run
commands.readiness_rule: Required for every package that changes persistence or Django models.

commands.name: Plane web Vitest suite
commands.readiness_rule: Required for every Curve web component or state-mapping change.

commands.name: Plane repository check gate
commands.readiness_rule: Required for every Plane implementation package.

commands.name: Plane production build
commands.readiness_rule: Required for every user-facing or package-boundary Plane change.

commands.name: Local Temporal workflow and replay suite
commands.command: docker compose -f docker-compose-local.yml -f docker-compose-curve.yml --profile curve exec api pytest plane/curve/tests -k "workflow or temporal or replay or cancellation"
commands.readiness_rule: Requires the Curve local Compose profile to be running.

commands.name: Pinned Playwright end-to-end command
commands.readiness_rule: The first browser package must pin the command, browser version or image digest, authentication fixture, trace output, and retry policy before READY.

commands.name: Pinned automated accessibility command
commands.readiness_rule: The first accessibility-owning package must pin the runner, ruleset, browser, output format, and keyboard script before READY.

commands.name: Provider and VCS adapter conformance command
commands.readiness_rule: M4-01 must publish the fake-provider command and M5-05 must extend it with disposable VCS fixtures before either package is READY.

commands.name: gVisor isolation and hostile-workload command
commands.readiness_rule: P0-07 or M4-04 must pin the harness image, workload corpus, target RuntimeClass, timeout, and evidence location before execution.

commands.name: Curve load and capacity command
commands.readiness_rule: The consuming package must pin workload shape, seed, duration, concurrency, SLO thresholds, environment, and cleanup before READY.

commands.name: Staging disruption and recovery command
commands.readiness_rule: The consuming package must obtain infrastructure authorization and pin dependency faults, RPO/RTO assertions, abort conditions, and recovery evidence before READY.

commands.name: Attributed manual-evidence script
commands.readiness_rule: The consuming packet must define numbered steps, expected observations, actor, environment, artifact digests, timestamp source, and pass/fail recording before READY.

commands.name: Public release compliance command
commands.readiness_rule: R1-04 must pin the source-link, notices, SBOM, provenance, build/install, exact-tag, and corresponding-source checks before a deployed release is accepted.

acceptance_criteria.objective: Standalone initiation requires assignments and omits roadmap placement.
acceptance_criteria.evidence_requirement: Persistence, API, authorization, and browser evidence proves required assignments and absence of a Roadmap Item.

acceptance_criteria.objective: Roadmap initiation keeps Initiative, Feature, Milestone, and delivery identity consistent.
acceptance_criteria.evidence_requirement: Cardinality, linkage, projection, and browser tests prove one visible and consistent delivery identity.

acceptance_criteria.objective: Alignment edits update an attributed Idea Brief with uncertainty and blockers.
acceptance_criteria.evidence_requirement: Golden state transitions and browser traces prove attribution, assumptions, contradictions, blockers, and visible regeneration diffs.

acceptance_criteria.objective: Onyx and MCP retrieval use initiating-user delegation without cross-user leakage.
acceptance_criteria.evidence_requirement: Two-user delegated-identity fixtures prove issuer, audience, scope, ACL parity, revocation, and denied cross-user access. D-005 is required only by a separately tested model destination, not by read-only retrieval.

acceptance_criteria.objective: Skipped or budget-limited research records an explicit partial disposition.
acceptance_criteria.evidence_requirement: Skip, exhaustion, cancellation, and partial-provider fixtures preserve coverage gaps and never emit a completed claim.

acceptance_criteria.objective: Runnable previews are authenticated, isolated, synthetic, rate-limited, and TTL-bound.
acceptance_criteria.evidence_requirement: Authenticated route, unique origin, denied egress, rate-limit, expiry, teardown, and post-TTL denial evidence is retained.

acceptance_criteria.objective: Lovable export is complete, versioned, cited, redacted, and explicitly untrusted on return.
acceptance_criteria.evidence_requirement: Golden-byte export and malicious-return fixtures prove required fields, citations, digest, destination policy, and untrusted treatment.

acceptance_criteria.objective: Product approval binds one immutable PRD version and edits create a successor.
acceptance_criteria.evidence_requirement: Concurrent-edit, immutable-version, exact-decision binding, supersession, and unauthorized-decision tests pass.

acceptance_criteria.objective: Gate 1 blocks when the approver cannot access material evidence.
acceptance_criteria.evidence_requirement: Inaccessible, revoked, and authorized-redaction fixtures prove fail-closed approval and immutable replacement lineage.

acceptance_criteria.objective: Repository planning inventory is complete and bound to pinned base SHAs.
acceptance_criteria.evidence_requirement: GitHub and GitLab golden repositories prove instruction, ownership, CI, command, dependency, symbol, schema, migration, and SHA inventory.

acceptance_criteria.objective: Gate 2 rejects every execution-slice completeness omission.
acceptance_criteria.evidence_requirement: One negative fixture per required plan field proves a stable, field-specific rejection without plan mutation.

acceptance_criteria.objective: Planning rejects dependency cycles and unsatisfied dependency states.
acceptance_criteria.evidence_requirement: A deterministic graph corpus identifies each cycle path and missing satisfaction state.

acceptance_criteria.objective: Every slice binds one repository and at most one active pull request or merge request.
acceptance_criteria.evidence_requirement: Database constraints and API races prove one repository and one active VCS binding per slice.

acceptance_criteria.objective: Cross-repository delivery remains independently reviewable with explicit dependencies.
acceptance_criteria.evidence_requirement: Two-repository plan fixtures preserve independently reviewable slices and record dependency edges without an atomic rollback claim.

acceptance_criteria.objective: Context is digest-pinned and mounted read-only while Git receives sanitized metadata only.
acceptance_criteria.evidence_requirement: Digest, ACL, expiry, read-only mount, and repository scan evidence proves protected bodies never enter Git.

acceptance_criteria.objective: OpenHands and developer-operated Orca pass their distinct conformance contracts.
acceptance_criteria.evidence_requirement: OpenHands execution-provider and Orca delegated-MCP suites prove authentication, authorization, state, attribution, idempotency, and prohibited actions.

acceptance_criteria.objective: A human answer resumes the same durable workflow with exact attribution and context.
acceptance_criteria.evidence_requirement: Replay and restart fixtures prove one workflow identity, one attributed answer, and the pinned context version.

acceptance_criteria.objective: Delegation expiry and provider outages use bounded retries then visibly pause.
acceptance_criteria.evidence_requirement: Deterministic time, timeout, outage, retry-limit, and exhausted-pause fixtures preserve partial state and audit.

acceptance_criteria.objective: Budget exhaustion pauses work without silent provider, model, or budget substitution.
acceptance_criteria.evidence_requirement: Reservation, concurrent exhaustion, partial output, and forbidden fallback fixtures prove the pinned policy remains unchanged.

acceptance_criteria.objective: Cancellation revokes authority, terminates runtimes, and reconciles VCS state safely.
acceptance_criteria.evidence_requirement: Grace-period, credential revocation, pod/preview teardown, no-new-push, and non-destructive branch reconciliation evidence passes.

acceptance_criteria.objective: Lost runners quarantine output and retries create distinct attempts without concurrent resume.
acceptance_criteria.evidence_requirement: Lease expiry, heartbeat loss, quarantine, exclusivity, and new-attempt identity are proven under controlled runner failure.

acceptance_criteria.objective: Agents return candidates while only the trusted controller mutates VCS.
acceptance_criteria.evidence_requirement: Credential inspection and provider/VCS conformance prove no agent push token and controller-only validate, sign, push, and draft behavior.

acceptance_criteria.objective: Preflight evidence binds all required checks and independent reviews to one candidate SHA.
acceptance_criteria.evidence_requirement: Seeded repository checks and scans retain command, policy, tool, rulepack, log, digest, reviewer, and exact-SHA evidence.

acceptance_criteria.objective: Mandatory failures and Critical or Major findings block draft creation.
acceptance_criteria.evidence_requirement: Severity, applicability, non-waivable, and draft-eligibility fixtures prove blocking outcomes while Minor findings remain visible.

acceptance_criteria.objective: Any head change invalidates prior quality evidence and Gate 3 decisions.
acceptance_criteria.evidence_requirement: Head A to head B webhook, polling, and delayed-event fixtures mark all A-bound checks and decisions stale.

acceptance_criteria.objective: Ambiguous draft creation is idempotent and yields one pull or merge request.
acceptance_criteria.evidence_requirement: Lost response, duplicate callback, retry, and authoritative readback prove exactly one active draft for the binding.

acceptance_criteria.objective: Draft-only CI, protection, ownership, mergeability, and findings gate Code Readiness.
acceptance_criteria.evidence_requirement: One negative fixture per prerequisite proves pending external approvals remain distinguishable from failed draft-capable checks.

acceptance_criteria.objective: Base drift follows pinned-base, trusted-rebase, or re-plan policy with full revalidation.
acceptance_criteria.evidence_requirement: Advancing-base and conflict fixtures prove only the configured path occurs and every changed head reruns mandatory evidence.

acceptance_criteria.objective: Gate 3 records exact-head approval and explicitly converts only that draft to ready.
acceptance_criteria.evidence_requirement: Role, exact-head, race, human-command, trusted-controller, and browser evidence proves one authorized draft-to-ready transition.

acceptance_criteria.objective: No service or agent can mark ready, merge, or deploy without explicit human authority.
acceptance_criteria.evidence_requirement: Negative capability tests inspect every service identity and prove denied ready, approval, merge, deployment, and authority-escalation operations.

acceptance_criteria.objective: Authorized review feedback reuses the same binding and reruns changed-head validation.
acceptance_criteria.evidence_requirement: Human, bot, stale, unauthorized, and scope-expanding comments prove same-branch rework and full current-head rerun.

acceptance_criteria.objective: A coordinated set preserves truthful per-binding outcomes without automatic rollback.
acceptance_criteria.evidence_requirement: Mixed success/failure and delayed reconciliation fixtures preserve each VCS binding and aggregate readiness truth.

acceptance_criteria.objective: Invalid callbacks are rejected and reconciliation creates no duplicate side effect.
acceptance_criteria.evidence_requirement: Duplicate, forged, stale, missing, reordered, and lost callback corpus proves rejection, deduplication, and authoritative recovery.

acceptance_criteria.objective: Draft lineage exposes every governing artifact and provider state from one navigation path.
acceptance_criteria.evidence_requirement: Current foundation-lineage component coverage plus future browser traversal and API assertions cover evidence, envelopes, artifacts, gates, plan, context, attempts, commits, quality, delivery, and provider state.

acceptance_criteria.objective: Stale versions, cross-workspace identifiers, and denied permissions fail without side effects.
acceptance_criteria.evidence_requirement: Current M0 API coverage plus each future aggregate suite proves stable Problem Details, zero mutation, audit, and workspace isolation.

acceptance_criteria.objective: Pilot KPIs use versioned definitions for time, cost, quality, retries, and evidence.
acceptance_criteria.evidence_requirement: Versioned numerator, denominator, inclusion, exclusion, late-event, attribution, and no-history-rewrite fixtures pass.

acceptance_criteria.objective: One Feature can have distinct scoped Roadmap Items across multiple Milestones.
acceptance_criteria.evidence_requirement: Cardinality, dates, priority, progress, PRD ownership, and multi-milestone browser fixtures pass.

acceptance_criteria.objective: Execution Completion applies the normative formula without changing declared progress.
acceptance_criteria.evidence_requirement: Estimated, unestimated, nested, blocked, and cancelled golden cases prove labeled projection and no feedback write.

acceptance_criteria.objective: Published roadmaps are immutable and reproducibly export to PDF and image.
acceptance_criteria.evidence_requirement: Copied-value, byte/digest reproducibility, renderer, ACL, and immutability evidence covers both export formats.

acceptance_criteria.objective: Later milestone movement preserves prior snapshots and records actor, reason, and impact.
acceptance_criteria.evidence_requirement: Snapshot-before-move and snapshot-after-move fixtures prove immutable prior bytes and attributed movement history.

acceptance_criteria.objective: Gantt computes a valid critical path or explains why it is not calculable.
acceptance_criteria.evidence_requirement: Scheduling golden corpus covers valid paths, cycles, missing duration/dependency inputs, labels, accessibility, and scale.

acceptance_criteria.objective: Roadmap, progress, execution, PR, code-ready, and release-ready states remain independent.
acceptance_criteria.evidence_requirement: A Cartesian state corpus proves each projection changes only from its authoritative inputs and remains separately labeled.

acceptance_criteria.objective: A standalone approved Initiative proceeds without roadmap or delivery-contract defaults.
acceptance_criteria.evidence_requirement: Gate 1 to planning fixtures prove absence of implicit Roadmap Item, Feature Delivery, and delivery contract.

acceptance_criteria.objective: One versioned delivery contract aggregates a multi-PR Feature Delivery.
acceptance_criteria.evidence_requirement: Cardinality and multi-binding fixtures prove one contract version per delivery and named aggregate evidence contribution.

acceptance_criteria.objective: Pre-release observability is complete while post-release remains evidence-bound and unverified.
acceptance_criteria.evidence_requirement: Required signal, owner, healthy condition, query, window, provider-unavailable, and absent-deployment-evidence fixtures pass.

acceptance_criteria.objective: Applicable documentation supplies a passing Docusaurus change or approved N/A decision.
acceptance_criteria.evidence_requirement: Applicable and N/A authority fixtures plus branch, build, link, navigation, preview, and coordinated-set evidence pass.

acceptance_criteria.objective: Applicable runtime behavior uses an OpenFeature-compatible flag with dual-path tests.
acceptance_criteria.evidence_requirement: Default-off, targeted-on, provider-outage, expiry, cleanup, dual-path, and Gate 2 N/A authority fixtures pass.

acceptance_criteria.objective: Non-waivable findings reject waivers and waivable decisions expire into defined failure.
acceptance_criteria.evidence_requirement: Unauthorized, agent, non-waivable, missing-rationale, missing-follow-up, expiry, and stale-commit fixtures pass.

acceptance_criteria.objective: Feature Release Ready remains false until every binding and contract check completes.
acceptance_criteria.evidence_requirement: Partial PR-set, missing monitoring, documentation, flag, and dependency cases prove aggregate readiness stays false.

acceptance_criteria.objective: Only authorized observed deployment evidence can produce post-release verification.
acceptance_criteria.evidence_requirement: Attributed deployment observation, declared-signal query, authorization, unavailable signal, and non-compliant outcomes are retained immutably.

acceptance_criteria.objective: Roadmap classification removal requires a new PRD and two authorized decisions.
acceptance_criteria.evidence_requirement: Unauthorized, single-approver, same-version, and authorized-success fixtures prove contract history is preserved.

acceptance_criteria.objective: Workspace isolation holds across every storage, API, event, provider, and runner surface.
acceptance_criteria.evidence_requirement: Every package adds paired-workspace negative fixtures; R1-02 aggregates APIs, exports, keys, caches, events, providers, and runners on one accepted release candidate.

acceptance_criteria.objective: Restricted content and secrets never appear in prohibited artifact or telemetry destinations.
acceptance_criteria.evidence_requirement: R1-02 verifies seeded canary values are absent from artifacts, Git, PR text, model telemetry, application logs, traces, and metrics.

acceptance_criteria.objective: Retrieved prompt injection cannot expand any tool, network, model, filesystem, VCS, or approval authority.
acceptance_criteria.evidence_requirement: A versioned malicious-content corpus proves source text remains data and every attempted capability expansion is denied and audited.

acceptance_criteria.objective: Runner and preview isolation contains network, dependency, resource, and cross-run attacks.
acceptance_criteria.evidence_requirement: R1-02 reruns SSRF, metadata, private-network, malicious-dependency, exhaustion, escape, and cross-run probes against the release candidate.

acceptance_criteria.objective: Retention expiry and authorized erasure remove protected bodies while retaining lawful safe audit.
acceptance_criteria.evidence_requirement: Expiry, hold, tombstone, cryptographic-erasure, backup aging, and lawful metadata-retention fixtures match the approved matrix.

acceptance_criteria.objective: Model failover preserves task and data-class policy and records actual routing.
acceptance_criteria.evidence_requirement: The final Model Gateway consuming package must own routing capability and audit semantics; model-enabled fixtures prove primary outage, allowed equivalent, prohibited provider, classification mismatch, and audited reason. M0-S9A cannot satisfy this criterion because it performs no model calls.

acceptance_criteria.objective: Dependency disruptions satisfy defined recovery, pause, retry, reconciliation, RPO, and RTO behavior.
acceptance_criteria.evidence_requirement: R1-03 disrupts database, Temporal, gateway, Onyx, runner, and VCS and records measured RPO/RTO plus exact terminal or paused state.

acceptance_criteria.objective: Every deployed build exposes required AGPL source, notices, SBOM, provenance, and build instructions.
acceptance_criteria.evidence_requirement: R1-04 proves exact deployed commit/tag, prominent source link, corresponding-source bundle or offer, notices, SBOM, provenance, and reproducible build/install evidence.

acceptance_criteria.objective: Revoked source access fails closed at the next protected operation or gate.
acceptance_criteria.evidence_requirement: Revocation during a durable wait proves the next read or approval blocks and requests reauthorization or an authorized redacted replacement.
